item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 1-2 Hull City
item.description: Wrexham AFC fell to a narrow 2-1 defeat against play-off rivals Hull City, despite Nathan Broadhead’s 76th-minute strike. Joe Gelhardt opened the scoring from distance with a strongly struck free-kick in the 40th minute, before Arthur Okonkwo saved his penalty just two minutes later. Lewis Koumas doubled the visitors’ advantage in the second half, before fellow Cymru international Broadhead got a goal back for the Red Dragons.
